summary: Rogers Road is classified as a "minor arterial" roadway having one lane of traffic in each direction with a bicycle lane and the legal speed limit being 40 km/hour. Boon Avenue is a 2-lane roadway designated as a "local roadway" with one-way northbound traffic from St. Clair Avenue West to Rogers Road and a 2-way traffic direction from Eversfield Road to Rogers Road. The adjacent land use along this road section of Rogers Road is primarily residential with some commercial properties. The Toronto Transit Commission (Rogers Road 161) services bus stops that are located at the east and west approaches of the intersection of Rogers Road/Boon Avenue. To address pedestrian safety concerns, residents are requesting the installation of a Pedestrian Crossover at the intersection of Rogers Road and Boon Avenue.
decided: City Council on July 23, 24, 25, 26, 27 and 30, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council approve the installation of traffic control signals at the intersection of Rogers Road and Boon Avenue.
